To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) category information can be used to organize search results in order to help users more quickly and accurately evaluate search results, 2) category names are more effective for this purpose than titles, 3) category names are most effective when they are used in conjunction with titles, and 4) category information is most effective when the categories are presented in an organized, visually distinct manner.
the best category interface was the one that showed the page title, category name and category icon, and that the best list interface was the one with the category names.
the category interfaces are better for users in finding the information that they are looking for.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of interfaces for integrating semantic information into Web search results.
the problem of optimizing search by presenting search results to users in context.
the problem of how to improve the effectiveness of Web search.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
category information is useful in helping users to find relevant documents in a search engine result set.
category interfaces provide the most effective search results interface.
Category interfaces are more effective for Web search results, even when list interfaces are augmented with category names.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
category groupings help users find what they are looking for more quickly and with less cognitive effort than lists.
users can quickly identify the most relevant results from a search when they are shown in context with other results in a category.
the most effective search interface is one that presents search results in the context of the categories they belong to.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the most effective way to integrate category information into Web search results is to present both the category name and individual page title for each search result, and to organize the results so that items from the same category are grouped visually.
search interfaces should present category groupings, even when the search engine does not support this functionality.
search results should be grouped by category, and the categories should be shown in a prominent location.
